plainLanguage: The chest muscle works during a barbell bench press, both its upper and lower parts.
qualifiers: Electromyography measures activation, not force and not growth; master plan section 2.2 prohibits presenting it as a measurement of hypertrophy.
Surface EMG over this muscle carries the measurement qualifier in claim-pectoralis-major-surface-emg-limitation.
Samples of twelve to thirty-five participants, mostly male.

conditions: barbell flat bench press at loads from 60 per cent of 1RM to 10RM

statement: The pectoralis major is measurably activated during the barbell flat bench press, at both its clavicular and sternocostal regions.
